name: Korea Circuit Co., Ltd.
summary: Korea Circuit Co., Ltd. operates as a global producer and vendor of printed circuit boards (PCBs). Its extensive product portfolio features high-density interconnect (HDI) solutions, advanced package substrates, and rigid-flexible PCBs. These critical components find application in a diverse range of electronic equipment, encompassing consumer goods like digital televisions and personal computers, as well as portable devices such as smartphones, IC modules, solid-state drives (SSDs), LCD products, personal digital assistants (PDAs), and various memory technologies. Established in 1964, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in Ansan, South Korea.
